summary.text: Richard Swanson is a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 32, in the November 3, 2026 general election. He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Richard Swanson was a Democratic candidate for New Hampshire House of Representatives Hillsborough 32 in the November 8, 2022 general election, in which three Republicans won the district's seats, according to Ballotpedia.
